title: Sizzling Garlic Prawns (Gambas al Ajillo) with Chilli and Parsley
summary: Lightly salted prawns are cooked quickly in olive oil slowly infused with garlic and chilli, then finished with parsley and lemon and served with crusty bread.
equipment: 30 cm cast-iron or heavy frying pan (or a terracotta cazuela)

ingredients.item: large raw prawns, peeled and deveined
fine sea salt or table salt
chilli flakes, or 2 small dried red chillies

steps.title: Salt the prawns
steps.text: Pat the prawns dry, toss with the salt and chill 15 minutes.

steps.title: Infuse the oil
steps.text: Put the oil, garlic and chilli in a cold pan and heat over medium-low for 6-8 minutes until the garlic is pale gold. Do not let it brown.

steps.title: Cook the prawns
steps.text: Raise the heat to medium, add the prawns in one layer and cook 2 minutes. Turn and cook 1-2 minutes more until pink and opaque all the way through (63 °C).

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Off the heat, stir in the parsley and lemon juice.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve sizzling from the pan with bread to dip in the garlic oil.

tips: Starting the garlic in cold oil infuses it without burning.
Pull the prawns as soon as they are opaque; they keep cooking in the hot oil.
A shallow cast-iron pan or terracotta cazuela keeps everything sizzling at the table.
storage: Best eaten straight away. Refrigerate leftovers within 1 hour, eat within 1 day and reheat gently until just hot (63 °C). Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
